models.note: Current depth model. Cache writes 1.25x (5m) / 2x (1h) input; cache reads 0.05x input. Verified against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-09-25.
Continuity model (one generation back). Cache write 1.25x (5m) / 2x (1h), cache read 0.1x.

Mid tier; input/output as Sonnet 5. Multipliers on $2: write 5m 1.25x, 1h 2x; cache hits and refreshes 0.05x (Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 rate). Verified against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-10-12.

Economy tier. Standard multipliers (write 5m 1.25x, 1h 2x, read 0.1x) on $0.10 input; prompts over 100,000 input tokens bill the whole request at $0.50/$2.50 with the same multipliers. Verified against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-10-12.
Premium always-on-thinking model. 2x Opus on input/output; cache writes 5m $12.50, 1h $20.00; cache reads $0.25 (0.025x input).

Verified against developers.openai.com/api/docs/models on 2026-10-01. Permanent price. Cache writes 1.25x uncached input (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching). Long context above 272K: 2x input and cache read, 1.5x output; long-context write 1.25x long-context input.
GPT-6 Astra, 'pro' channel. Same cache and long-context rules as GPT-6.1 Sol.

Launch pricing through 2026-11-30; standard rates from 2026-12-01. Implicit caching only (no explicit cache, so no storage charge); cache read is the implicit-hit rate. No long-context tier. Verified against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing on 2026-10-13.
